# Long horizons (72 h, 168 h): single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_long_horizons.py`)

Git commit `3c740b1992`. Scenario A, same samples for all models, 3 seeds, mean prediction. MAE in MW. Models fitted on the training period only with the validation-chosen configuration.

## Horizon 72 h (train samples 19,803; test samples 8,611)

| model | test MAE (MW) | MAPE % | skill vs best naive |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| persistence | 7,676 | 4.01 |  |
| same hour 3 or 7 days earlier | 7,676 | 4.01 |  |
| snaive168 | 8,476 | 4.41 |  |
| ridge | 6,244 | 3.26 | +18.7% |
| XGBoost S4 | 6,018 | 3.14 | +21.6% |
| LSTM L4 | 6,200 | 3.25 | +19.2% |

Paired differences (MAE of first minus second; negative = first better; 95% block bootstrap):

| first | second | difference (MW) | 95% CI |
|---|---|---:|---|
| XGBoost S4 | ridge | -225 | -506 to +46 |
| LSTM L4 | XGBoost S4 | +182 | -201 to +552 |
| LSTM L4 | ridge | -43 | -429 to +280 |
